description: `cli delete` suggests `cli program delete --help`, and the Action names `cli job delete`. (JSON envelope)

problem.action: A job is deleted with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Use `cli program delete SLUG`; `prose --output json cli program delete --help` shows its arguments.

details.reason: unknown command `cli delete`; did you mean `cli program delete SLUG`? runs are never deleted; a saved program is deleted with `cli program delete SLUG` and a job with `cli job delete JOB_ID`
